Versions with 30+ runs: success 77%-98%. 321 of 2556 runs (13%) have no confirmed merge; 0 have a measured 14-day rework or survival.
Success counts outcome=='success' unless merged is False (prompts/promptctl.py), so an unconfirmed self-report counts as success.

## 3. The retire rule on small counts

- ventures: issues per run 1/633 (champion 1) vs 0/163 (candidate 2); runs with any issue 1 vs 0; Fisher exact two-sided p = 1.00.
- research: issues per run 7/861 (champion 0) vs 1/178 (candidate 1); runs with any issue 5 vs 1; Fisher exact two-sided p = 1.00.
- process: issues per run 1/247 (champion 1) vs 0/10 (candidate 2); runs with any issue 1 vs 0; Fisher exact two-sided p = 1.00.
- review: issues per run 0/67 (champion 1) vs 0/13 (candidate 2); runs with any issue 0 vs 0; Fisher exact two-sided p = 1.00.

`measure` suggests retiring a candidate whenever its integrity issues per run exceed the champion's, with no significance test.
